title: Toddler Walking, Sunny Balcony Deck Shadows - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century deckle-edged snapshot capturing a toddler walking briskly along an outdoor wooden porch or balcony. The young child is bundled in a dark mid-length winter or autumn coat and light-colored baby shoes. Strong sunlight streams across the horizontal clapboard siding of the house and casts long grid-like geometric shadows across the wooden decking from the wire mesh protective railing on the left. Wooded foliage is visible beyond the railing in the background.
